lines.text: Many learners say: I wish it doesn't rain tomorrow.
Better: I hope it doesn't rain tomorrow.
For the future, use hope, not wish.
Hope! I hope you enjoy the party!

data.wrong: I wish it doesn't rain tomorrow.
data.right: I hope it doesn't rain tomorrow.
